job.job_description:
We are seeking a highly skilled GenAI Engineer with 4+ years of experience to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions for real-world business applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience delivering production-ready GenAI projects, with expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI solutions. The role involves building scalable AI applications on Azure and Databricks, integrating enterprise data into AI workflows, developing APIs, optimizing AI performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and secure AI-powered solutions.

Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions for real-world business applications.
Deliver production-ready GenAI projects with hands-on experience.
Work with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI solutions.
Build scalable AI applications on Azure and Databricks; integrate enterprise data into AI workflows; develop APIs; optimize AI performance.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and secure AI-powered solutions.
Requirements
4+ years of experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade Generative AI solutions.
Hands-on experience delivering production-ready GenAI projects.
Expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, AI workflow orchestration, and cloud-native AI solutions.
Building scalable AI applications on Azure and Databricks; integrating enterprise data into AI workflows; developing APIs; optimizing AI performance.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative and secure AI-powered solutions.
